tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations are monotone and concave but do not identify the gradient dependence. The open-branch probe directly supplies the needed wide-gradient discrimination at the lowest relevant cost; subsequent fitting should use all observations and the full wide parameter box.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span leaves vmax and rho nearly collinear, making their extrapolation to wider gradients unreliable.
The immediate ambiguity concerns gradient leverage and the local branch, not trajectory resolution; this probe also costs more.
The pilot is subcritical and the required high-gradient probe is not offered in the menu.
